job.job_description:
Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced MLOps Engineer to build and manage scalable infrastructure for AI/ML and Large Language Model (LLM) workloads from scratch. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in ML deployment pipelines, GPU infrastructure, Kubernetes, automation, and production model serving.

Key Responsibilities

Design and build end-to-end MLOps infrastructure for model training, deployment, monitoring, and inference.
Build CI/CD pipelines for ML models and automate model deployment, validation, and rollback.
Provision, configure, and optimize GPU-enabled infrastructure for AI/ML and LLM workloads.
Deploy and scale LLM inference and model-serving solutions in production environments.
Manage Kubernetes, Docker, infrastructure-as-code, and distributed computing environments.
Implement monitoring, logging, observability, and automated remediation for production AI workloads.
Optimize GPU/CPU utilization, inference latency, system performance, and infrastructure costs.
Collaborate with AI/ML engineers to build reliable, scalable, and high-performance AI platforms.

Required Skills

6+ years of experience in MLOps, ML Platform Engineering, SRE, DevOps, or Infrastructure Engineering.
Strong hands-on experience with GPU provisioning, GPU-enabled infrastructure, and AI/ML workloads.
Experience deploying and operating ML models and LLMs in production.
Strong knowledge of Kubernetes, Docker, and container orchestration.
Experience with Terraform, Ansible, Pulumi, or similar infrastructure-as-code tools.
Proficiency in Python or Go for automation and infrastructure tooling.
Experience with ML CI/CD, model serving, monitoring, Prometheus, Grafana, or OpenTelemetry.
Strong understanding of cloud infrastructure, Linux, networking, and distributed systems.

Good to Have

Experience with Ray, Slurm, vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, or Triton Inference Server.
Exposure to GPU clusters, distributed training, NVIDIA GPU technologies, NVLink, or InfiniBand.
Experience building AI infrastructure or MLOps platforms from scratch.

Preferred Candidate: Someone who can independently design, build, deploy, and optimize production-grade AI/ML and LLM infrastructurenot just maintain existing pipelines.
